{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel values in customer_age:", sales_df['customer_age'].unique())

# Check the distribution of channels and customer_segments
print("\nChannel distribution:", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if there's a confounding relationship between channel and customer_segment
print("\nChannel vs customer_segment cross-tab:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))"}
